what_changed: Build round: the first standard model for INTC (quarterly, 6 drivers). Revenue guides have landed at or above the midpoint 8 of 8 times (median +4.0%), so the record-adjusted Q4 is $16.1B; I build $15.78B (inside, +1.8%) from the segment directions because this guide carries quantified one-offs. FY27 model EPS $1.63 vs Street $1.91 (thin, partly pre-print). Research target (12m) $82.23 vs $96 (-14.3%). Shares 5,506M fully counted, NCI $16.6B, net cash $3.9B at 2026-09-26. Thesis break moved $70 -> $55 (products-only floor now ~$59). Stock closed $65.76 on 2026-10-30 (-28.6%).
